name: skills-engineering
description: Writes and audits Claude skills wherever they live, from personal, project and plugin folders to claude.ai accounts, the Skills API and URLs: authoring-skills learns your goal and setup, agrees a plan with you and builds the skill from the current official docs, and auditing-skills runs frontmatter checks, then nine specialized reviewer agents in parallel, each returning quoted file-and-line evidence, severity, an exact fix and a verdict.
